name: mod_kaiiv
description: Moodle build of the KAISER interactive video player (kaiiv-player/ at the repository root). Not published.

scripts.build: webpack --mode production && node tools/build-plain-amd.js && node ../../../kaiiv-player/tools/build-styles.js --moodle . && node tools/sync-player.js
scripts.dev: webpack --mode development && node tools/build-plain-amd.js && node ../../../kaiiv-player/tools/build-styles.js --moodle . && node tools/sync-player.js
